-- A name is usable only if it is one plain file name inside notes:
-- no separators, no "." or "..", no empty text, no NUL.
safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex safe_name("a.txt") == True
  ex safe_name("../secret") == False
  ex safe_name("") == False
  if name == "" or name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\" or c == "\0"
      return False
  True

-- Text of one note inside the notes directory, or None if it is
-- missing, unreadable, or its name is not safe.
read_note(name: str) -> str? uses fs =
  pre safe_name(name)
  fs.read(name) else None

-- First readable note in names, or "" when none can be read.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      if safe_name(name)
        let text = read_note(name)
        if text != None
          return text else ""
    ""
